acceptance.AC83-IDENTITY: Locked Streamlit OIDC adapter validates trusted issuer/subject/audience/authorized-party/iat/exp; deterministic local OIDC library tests reject invalid signature/issuer/audience/nonce and expired-cookie claims; no browser owner/token authentication.
acceptance.AC83-ACCESS: Two users cannot load, render, audit, inspect, decide, retry or delete each others reviews; all denial paths are sanitized and do not mutate, renew or call adapters; unmanaged/raw/maintenance routes cannot bypass.
acceptance.AC83-ATOMIC: Owner/lifecycle/first checkpoint or pending-write commits atomically before returning usable review reference; failed writes and deletion roll back all namespaces; immutable owners and existing exclusion/receipt visibility remain correct.
acceptance.AC83-ISOLATION: Immutable store-mode initialization lock rejects local/auth mispoint, corruption and legacy ownerless access; authenticated mode uses explicit dedicated PostgreSQL and no bulk prune; offline mode remains service-free.
acceptance.AC83-SESSION: Identity switch/logout/expiry/callbacks invalidate cached private state and confirmations; each private render and operation reauthorizes without claiming global revocation.
acceptance.AC83-REGRESSION: Existing graph JSON, financial/provenance/revision/receipt semantics remain unchanged; focused and full required static/offline/disposable real PostgreSQL tests pass with cleanup evidence and zero skipped required cases.
acceptance.AC83-DOCS: New ADR, Iteration018 first-slice plan/evidence, architecture/runbook/threat/secret configuration docs describe scope, setup, legacy and expiry limits; no secrets/private data committed.

invariants.I23OWNER: Every protected review has one immutable owner; unauthorized or missing identity fails before private reads, mutations, lifecycle operations or side effects.
invariants.I23IDENTITY: Authenticated identity comes from a trusted replaceable server boundary; a review UUID or client-supplied owner never authenticates.
invariants.I23STATE: Existing JSON graph state, financial controls, revision integrity, receipts and per-thread concurrency remain reliable; credentials never enter persisted graph state.
invariants.I23LEGACY: Existing ownerless checkpoints are never automatically claimed or exposed in authenticated mode.
invariants.I23OFFLINE: Offline single-user development remains explicit and service-free; authenticated deployment cannot silently fall back to it.
